subject.title: Dashboard: action-form widget — buttons and forms that dispatch the agent

question: Should OpenClaw accept a first-party dashboard action-form builtin that dispatches parameterized prompts, and should it wait until the Wave 1 dashboard substrate is merged?
rationale: The request adds a new user-facing action surface and a security-sensitive prompt-dispatch boundary; automation cannot choose the permanent product/security contract before the dashboard substrate settles.

options.title: Defer Behind Substrate
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical action-form follow-up until the dashboard plugin, workspaces UI, and custom-widget bridge are merged or rejected, then design the dispatch gate against that final surface.

options.title: Sponsor A Narrow Builtin
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly sponsor a small dashboard-plugin builtin now, but it should include template schema validation, field limits, confirmation/rate-limit reuse, and security tests in the first PR.

options.title: Move To External Widget Only
options.body: Maintainers can decide this should remain an external/custom widget pattern, but that would need a clear replacement story for safe first-party prompt dispatch.

recommendation.title: Defer Behind Substrate
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical action-form follow-up until the dashboard plugin, workspaces UI, and custom-widget bridge are merged or rejected, then design the dispatch gate against that final surface.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the current merged Control UI plugin-tab seam most directly in main and is the best available maintainer-side routing candidate for the product boundary decision.
